changes: First Modwerk catalog release of Sam Banks's MIDI mapping patch: CC68–73 control the six FX1 SETUP parameters.
Modwerk only repackages the upstream patch; the stock parts it changes are checked against your own firmware.
Now loads over USB on the Modwerk beta base; the site asks for a base update first.
Updated for newer beta bases on 14 and 22 Oct without changing the module itself; update the base first when the site asks.
Known issue: the USB package is not yet tested on hardware.
